UserHydrationProfile.title: User Hydration Profile
UserHydrationProfile.description: Stores a user's personalized hydration goal, preferred unit, quick-add preset volumes, and daily active hours.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User's display name shown in the sanctuary greeting.

dailyGoalMl.description: Daily hydration target in milliliters (500 to 10000).

quickPresetSmallMl.description: First quick-add droplet volume in mL.

quickPresetMediumMl.description: Second quick-add droplet volume in mL.

quickPresetLargeMl.description: Third quick-add droplet volume in mL.

wakeHour.description: Start hour of active hydration window (0-23).

sleepHour.description: End hour of active hydration window (0-23).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

HydrationLog.title: Hydration Log
HydrationLog.description: Individual beverage intake entry logged by a user on a specific calendar day.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the log owner.

amountMl.description: Raw consumed liquid volume in milliliters (1 to 5000).

effectiveMl.description: Hydration-factor adjusted volume in milliliters (1 to 6000).

dayKey.description: Local calendar day key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

loggedAtMillis.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the drink was logged.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user hydration preferences and daily goal configuration.

/users/{userId}/intakeLogs/{logId}.description: Per-user beverage intake logs scoped under the owner's user document.
